subject: Rebuild matrices and retrain -- decision gate G2
description:
3.1 rebuild all four categories locally (minutes). 3.2 full HPC retrain (P0053 runbook, 6 stages ~18.3 min -- retraining is NOT the schedule risk; the prose is).

GATE G2: if the retrained models do not beat current test WMAPE, DO NOT spend the $20 on re-running SRQ4. Report the re-engineering as a measured negative result and keep the v6 experiment as-is. A negative result here is publishable and costs nothing.

Re-running SRQ4 requires Brian's explicit approval -- it spends real money.
